caption: The drawing depicts a detailed representation of an eagle statue. The eagle is primarily brown, with darker shades accentuating the feathers on its outstretched wings and body. The bird's beak is yellow, and its talons are also visible, grasping an object that is part of the statue's base. The statue itself rests on a multi-tiered, hexagonal pedestal made of what appears to be a wood-like material with brown tones. The background is off-white and plain, with a fine rectangular border framing the central image. In the bottom left and bottom right corners, there are two small, red line-drawn sketches that show simplified outlines of the eagle statue from different angles. The drawing is oriented vertically on the page, and the composition centers the statue, making it the dominant feature.
title: Carved Eagle
